cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Efficiency Win
cards.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The dishwasher's broken. Excellent: curry in bread rolls, no plates. Slice horizontally, please; we need a base, not a sandwich slit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We have six rolls and twelve guests.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then both halves become dishes. Equal depth, please. Twice the service from the same bread.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The curry will run off the flat halves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Better still: hollow them without breaking the crust. Stir the crumbs into the curry. Gently, please; our thickener mustn't cost us the bowls.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 slice geometry, A3 equal halves and A5 crust-preserving hollowing turn expert cooking corrections into successive celebrated savings.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 guest ratio causes A3 using both halves; B4 runoff causes A5 hollow bowls and crumb thickening.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 identify supply and shape issues that directly improve A proposed process.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes material removed for B4 containment become thickener, a second efficiency gain earned by the same problem.
